# Eagle Eye P.I.

> Eagle Eye P.I. is a licensed private investigation and executive protection agency headquartered in East Orange, New Jersey, serving all of New Jersey and New York. Led by Francesco, a retired U.S. Department of Justice and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) ICE veteran with over 25 years of federal law enforcement experience.

## Core Services
- Covert Physical & Mobile Surveillance
- Infidelity & Matrimonial Investigation
- TSCM Digital Sweeps & Bug Detection (Andre Kit)
- Executive Protection & Armed Chauffeur Services
- Insurance & Workers' Compensation Fraud Investigation
- Attorney & Litigation Support (Witness Locates, Statements)
- Criminal Background Checks & OSINT Vetting
- Missing Person & Skip Tracing
- Fleet & Asset GPS Tracking
- Process Serving & Court Record Retrieval

## Jurisdiction & Contact
- Headquarters: East Orange, NJ (Serving Essex, Bergen, Hudson, Union, Passaic, and all 21 NJ counties, plus all 5 boroughs of NYC and Long Island).
